caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica often means riding where the grass grows tall and the lake wind picks up. When the trail narrows to a single line against the water, the focus shifts entirely to the next ten metres of dirt. It is a quiet way to cover ground, with nothing but the sound of the tires and the light changing over the surface of the lake.
